name: Find Strahd's Coffin
description: Count Strahd von Zarovich sleeps in one of many coffins hidden throughout the crypts. You must search the coffins to find and destroy him before he awakens.

objectives.description: Search coffin tokens to find Strahd's resting place

specialRules.description: Each explored tile receives a coffin token face-down. Search to reveal its contents.

specialRules.effect: If Strahd's coffin hasn't been found, he spawns on the nearest unexplored edge

introText: The crypts stretch before you, filled with dusty coffins. Somewhere among them lies Count Strahd himself. Search carefully - for disturbing the wrong coffin may bring dire consequences.
victoryText: You have found Strahd's Coffin! With a wooden stake driven through its heart, the vampire lord's reign of terror ends. The crypts grow quiet at last.
defeatText: The darkness closes in. Your names will be forgotten in the halls of Castle Ravenloft.
